18	1. `_levenshtein_norm(source: str, target: str) -> float` — normalized (0..1) Levenshtein distance, divided by max string length.

25	6. `_transform(pattern: _BranchPattern) -> _Either` — expands `(-a|-b) (-c|-d)` into a single Either.

findings.title: Fabricated runtime dependency `typing-extensions>=4.0.0` is never used and breaks network-less installation
findings.detail: /workspace/pyproject.toml declares `dependencies = ["typing-extensions>=4.0.0"]`. The string `typing_extensions` appears nowhere in the project except that one line — docopt/__init__.py imports only `re`, `sys` and names from the stdlib `typing` module. The spec-matching upstream snapshot (/tmp/pdmera/docopt-ng-89c784130b70aa9214daa8a6298459fa4ede8ea8/pyproject.toml) declares `dependencies = []`, and the released 0.9.0 sdist PKG-INFO (/tmp/src/docopt_ng-0.9.0/PKG-INFO) has no Requires-Dist line at all. Consequence for installability: the wheel METADATA carries `Requires-Dist: typing-extensions>=4.0.0`, so pip must resolve it. In a network-less environment whose target interpreter does not already have typing-extensions, `pip install .` fails outright at dependency resolution — even with --no-build-isolation, i.e. the failure is not a build-backend artifact. It only succeeded in my earlier runs because the network was up, or because the ambient /usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages already ships typing_extensions 4.14.1 (pip reported 'Requirement already satisfied ... (4.14.1)'). The dependency is also provably unnecessary at runtime.

findings.detail: Informational, and better than upstream rather than worse. With pip's default build isolation and no network, `pip install .` fails because pip must fetch `setuptools>=61` and `wheel` into the ephemeral build env. With `--no-build-isolation` it succeeds provided both setuptools and `wheel` are importable by the target interpreter; a bare `python3 -m venv` does NOT include `wheel`, and on the venv-bundled setuptools 65.5.0 that produces `error: invalid command 'bdist_wheel'` — an environment property, not a project defect (the ambient /usr/local python has wheel 0.40.0 and works).
